description: Parking bay arrivals and departures 2014 is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. The City of Melbourne has installed in-ground parking bay sensors in most CBD parking bays. These sensors record when a vehicle arrives and when it departs. Each record also includes the parking restriction for the bay and whether the vehicle has overstayed that restriction. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are changemaker, citizenreporter, entrepreneur, parking, sensors. The portal shows 2020-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
